press_references.value: Telecom Egypt Partners VIE Communities to Develop Smart Gated Communities in Egypt

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt and VIE Communities formed a new partnership to develop smart, highly connected gated residential communities in Egypt, combining Telecom Egypt’s digital infrastructure with VIE Communities’ real estate projects.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt and Huawei partner in historic first to bring seamless FTTR connectivity to Egyptian homes

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt and Huawei have formed a strategic partnership to launch and deploy Fiber-to-the-Room (FTTR) home connectivity services in Egypt, combining Telecom Egypt’s consumer operations with Huawei’s in-home fiber technology.

press_references.value: Egypt signs telecom agreements to boost mobile services, attract investment

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt and e& Egypt signed new commercial agreements with Egypt's National Telecommunications Regulatory Authority to enhance mobile services and attract further telecom investment.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt Establishes New Point of Presence at Aqaba Digital Hub

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt announced a collaboration with Aqaba Digital Hub to host a new Point of Presence at ADH in Aqaba, Jordan, complementing their jointly developed Coral Bridge subsea link with ADH’s telecom arm NaiTel.

press_references.value: Egypt, Jordan strengthen digital ties with Coral Bridge Cable

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt and Naitel, the telecommunications arm of Aqaba Digital City, announced a partnership to implement the Coral Bridge submarine cable, directly connecting Egypt and Jordan and enhancing digital infrastructure in the region.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt-consortium inks MoU to construct AAE-2 subsea cable

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt, Zain Omantel International, PCCW Global, and Sparkle announced a new partnership to develop the Asia-Africa-Europe-2 (AAE-2) subsea cable system, aiming to enhance intercontinental digital connectivity.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt, Cisco Activate Subsea Link Between Egypt and France

partnership_announcements.description: Activation of a Mediterranean subsea link on the 2Africa subsea cable system using Cisco's Network Convergence System (NCS).

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt Announces Successful Landing of Africa-1 Subsea Cable System

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom Egypt and partners announced the successful landing of the Africa-1 subsea cable system, enhancing connectivity across multiple regions.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt and Huawei partner in historic first to bring seamless FTTR connectivity to Egyptian homes

product_launches.description: Telecom Egypt, in collaboration with Huawei, has launched a new Fiber-to-the-Room (FTTR) home broadband service in Egypt, offering ultra-fast, low-latency in-home fiber connectivity and professional installation for households and SMEs.

press_references.value: Telecom Egypt’s Total Revenue Jumps 33% to EGP 50.6 Billion

product_launches.description: Telecom Egypt launched its 5G services in the first half of 2025, aiming to enhance customer experience and drive digital innovation.

press_references.value: WATCH: Nationwide 5G Services Launched at the Giza Pyramids

product_launches.description: Egypt's four telecom operators—Vodafone Egypt, Orange Egypt, Etisalat Misr, and Telecom Egypt—have launched nationwide 5G services, marking a major technological advancement in the country's telecommunications sector.

press_references.value: Smart Solar Energy Market: A New Era of Clean, Clever Power

product_launches.description: Telecom Egypt and Huawei launched Egypt's first solar-powered green tower, marking a milestone in smart, clean telecom infrastructure.

overview_description.description:
Telecom Egypt has witnessed great developments; it started in 1854 with the first telegraph line in Egypt and today it is the largest communication network in Egypt and the Middle East.

Telecom Egypt truly sits at the heart of the Egyptian telecommunications market and is the largest provider of fixed line services in the Middle East and Africa with 7.2 million subscribers, as at the end of March 2013.
